title: Prepare a bounded, repeatable report job
goal: Produce one private two-line report under its intended account.
challenge: Create a repeatable finite job with explicit environment. Prove two valid runs and detect incorrect root invocation without damaging the report.

steps.command: ! getent passwd ll-s2 && ! getent group ll-s2 && test ! -e /home/ll-s2 && sudo useradd -m -U -s /bin/bash ll-s2

printf '%s
' '#!/bin/bash' PATH=/usr/bin:/bin 'umask 077' '[ "$(id -un)" = ll-s2 ] || exit 2' 'cd /home/ll-s2 || exit 3' 'printf "user=%s
" "$(id -un)" > report.txt &&' 'printf "stamp=%s
" "$(date -Is)" >> report.txt' | sudo tee /home/ll-s2/job.sh > /dev/null && sudo chown ll-s2:ll-s2 /home/ll-s2/job.sh && sudo chmod 0700 /home/ll-s2/job.sh
steps.explanation: Short script overwrites, uses deliberate PATH and refuses wrong identity.
steps.expected: Private two-line report, no unbounded append.

steps.command: sudo runuser -u ll-s2 -- /usr/bin/timeout -k 1s 5s /home/ll-s2/job.sh; printf "status=%s\n" "$?"; sudo runuser -u ll-s2 -- cat /home/ll-s2/report.txt; sudo stat -c "%U:%G %a %s" /home/ll-s2/report.txt
steps.expected: Status0, owner ll-s2, mode600, under256 bytes.

steps.command: sudo runuser -u ll-s2 -- /usr/bin/timeout -k 1s 5s /home/ll-s2/job.sh; sudo /home/ll-s2/job.sh; printf "wrong identity status=%s\n" "$?"
steps.explanation: Repeat safely, deliberately try wrong root identity.

hints: Check contents/owner as well as status.
Root can bypass permissions; use ll-s2.
review: Two runs; private owner/mode; root status2.
coverage: LPIC-1 v5.0 107.2 partial cron/systemd timers; 105.2/108.2 reinforcement; self-reviewed, unscored. No at or full objective coverage.
